name: kata
description: A workflow + project memory layer for AI-paired engineering. Builders inherit a kata, adapt it to their project, and eventually transcend the form. Compiles business semantics (the part code-quality LLMs can't infer), manages spec authoring + disagreement, and lets agents read project conventions before they write code. 13 skills (init, import, ingest, search, graph, tier, digest, query, lint, config, dream, watch, sync) on a Karpathy-style llm-wiki substrate. Multi-CLI session ingest in flight (v1.11).
